strategic_capability_mapping.transition: Subtask orchestration, handoff preparation, dispatch readiness, guard verdict, candidate manifest, handoff envelope, and parent-join continuation ledger payloads move from versioned-open contracts to strict typed validation with v1 through v10 read compatibility.
strategic_capability_mapping.why_now: The remaining protocol-event-canonization blocker is full LedgerEvent payload typing. The subtask orchestration and dispatch family is the next bounded family because it records parent/child orchestration, dispatcher admission, candidate selection, handoff envelope evidence, and parent-join continuation consumption used by autonomous resume/replay.
strategic_capability_mapping.evidence: brownie-store validates strict SubtaskOrchestrationQueued, SubtaskHandoffPrepared, SubtaskSchedulerReadinessRecorded, SubtaskDispatchPlanPrepared, SubtaskDispatchContractPrepared, SubtaskDispatchAdmissionEvaluated, SubtaskDispatchReadinessSnapshotRecorded, SubtaskDispatcherGuardVerdictRecorded, SubtaskDispatchDecisionRecorded, SubtaskDispatchCandidateManifestRecorded, SubtaskDispatchHandoffEnvelopeRecorded, and ParentJoinContinuationFingerprintConsumed payload fields before append/read, preserves legacy v1 through v10 payload-envelope read compatibility, and the generated semantic contract records strict_typed closed status for those families.
strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Narrows the protocol-event-canonization release blocker with strict typed subtask orchestration and dispatch ledger payload contracts so autonomous resume/replay can depend on bounded subtask dispatch evidence.

answers.strategic_capabilities: RRP-5.15 advances protocol-event-canonization by moving subtask orchestration, handoff, dispatch readiness, dispatch decision, candidate manifest, handoff envelope, and parent-join continuation ledger event families to strict typed payload validation while preserving explicit release-blocking debt for remaining open payload families.
answers.new_capability: New SubtaskOrchestrationQueued, SubtaskHandoffPrepared, SubtaskSchedulerReadinessRecorded, SubtaskDispatchPlanPrepared, SubtaskDispatchContractPrepared, SubtaskDispatchAdmissionEvaluated, SubtaskDispatchReadinessSnapshotRecorded, SubtaskDispatcherGuardVerdictRecorded, SubtaskDispatchDecisionRecorded, SubtaskDispatchCandidateManifestRecorded, SubtaskDispatchHandoffEnvelopeRecorded, and ParentJoinContinuationFingerprintConsumed payloads reject unknown fields, malformed field types, missing bounded subtask orchestration/dispatch/parent-join evidence, and unbounded raw plan or raw assistant content before durable append/read.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: RRP-5.14 made tool planning and intent parsing events strict typed, but subtask orchestration and dispatch events still accepted arbitrary versioned-open payloads despite carrying replay-relevant parent/child dispatch and parent-join evidence.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie could still record malformed subtask orchestration, dispatch, candidate manifest, handoff envelope, or parent-join continuation evidence while claiming protocol-event-canonization progress.
answers.non_duplicative: This is the RRP-5.15 subtask orchestration and dispatch event-family slice; it does not repeat RRP-5.5 inventory, RRP-5.6 known-field checks, RRP-5.7 terminal task typing, RRP-5.8 core permission typing, RRP-5.9 selected tool admission typing, RRP-5.10 MCP/tool terminal typing, RRP-5.11 Codebase Index/verification context typing, RRP-5.12 task/LLM lifecycle typing, RRP-5.13 task admission/mode-resolution typing, RRP-7.2 durability/deadline work, or CI workflow hardening.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. RRP-5.15 adds no JSON-RPC method and only hardens durable ledger payload validation plus generated contract evidence.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The generated semantic contract and audit files are guard evidence, not a new user-facing Runtime summary surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Ledger appends with payloads for SubtaskOrchestrationQueued, SubtaskHandoffPrepared, SubtaskSchedulerReadinessRecorded, SubtaskDispatchPlanPrepared, SubtaskDispatchContractPrepared, SubtaskDispatchAdmissionEvaluated, SubtaskDispatchReadinessSnapshotRecorded, SubtaskDispatcherGuardVerdictRecorded, SubtaskDispatchDecisionRecorded, SubtaskDispatchCandidateManifestRecorded, SubtaskDispatchHandoffEnvelopeRecorded, and ParentJoinContinuationFingerprintConsumed now use strict schemas, reject additional fields, and validate required bounded subtask orchestration and dispatch evidence before writing or reading.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless resume/replay gains stronger subtask orchestration and dispatch evidence because these ledger payloads are no longer versioned-open during new writes.
answers.milestone_progress: Narrows protocol-event-canonization from 33 to 21 release-blocking open payload families while keeping Runtime Release Ready false until remaining payload families, runtime-release-guard-ci, and owner license/publish/release decisions are resolved.

safety_boundary: Rust Runtime/protocol/store remain execution, admission, replay, permission, MCP, workspace mutation, durable state, protocol, and completion authority.
CLI and VSIX remain thin transport/projection clients and cannot grant Runtime authority.
Raw prompt, provider output, file content, absolute/canonical path, secret, environment value, executable content, and process output are not persisted as release evidence.
non_goals: Does not claim Runtime Release Ready.
Does not claim every LedgerEvent payload is strictly typed.
Does not change license, publish settings, tags, release assets, or public OSS release posture.
Does not add hosted scheduler, daemon, worker fleet, queue, generic shell, arbitrary process execution, remote Git expansion, signing infrastructure, or external platform products.
Does not modify .github workflow files; runtime-release-guard-ci remains a separate blocker.
Does not reopen or alter the closed RRP-7.2 platform-deadline-durability baseline.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected docs-only closure because semantic compatibility needs generated fixtures and executable tests.
Rejected VSIX-owned schema generation because Runtime/protocol must own public wire semantics.
Rejected adding new RPCs because the closure concerns existing protocol compatibility.
technical_debt: protocol-event-canonization remains required-before-release for strict typed, payload-absent, or legacy-only schema assignments across every remaining open LedgerEventKind payload family.
runtime-release-guard-ci remains open Runtime-owned debt until workflow-scope credentials or owner-approved equivalent CI hardening exists.
Owner license/publish/release decisions remain required before OSS Release Ready.
next_capability_rationale: Continue bounded strict ledger payload coverage slices until protocol-event-canonization closes, then return to runtime-release-guard-ci only when workflow-scope credentials or an owner-approved equivalent path is available.

runtime_release_dod: RRP-5.5 corrects protocol-event-canonization scope so RPC contracts and payload fingerprint split stay closed while full ledger payload typing remains required-before-release; RRP-5.6 through RRP-5.15 progressively close terminal task, permission, selected tool, MCP approval, tool terminal, Codebase Index, verification recovery context, task/LLM lifecycle, task admission/mode-resolution, tool planning/intent parsing, and subtask orchestration/dispatch payload families without claiming full ledger payload typing.
Runtime Release Ready remains false until remaining Runtime blockers and owner license/publish/release decisions are resolved.
runtime_boundary_contracts: No new RPC surface is added; existing Runtime JSON-RPC and ledger semantics are preserved and more strictly checked.
CLI and VSIX remain thin clients over Runtime-owned contracts.
external_control_plane_responsibilities: External scheduling, queueing, worker leases, hosted isolation, retry policy, metrics, alerts, SLA, tenant administration, billing, and secret-provider operations remain outside this local Runtime v0 phase.
external_adapter_responsibilities: Forge, pull request, review, notification, SIEM, OTel, language verifier, customer integration, and hosted MCP adapter responsibilities remain outside RRP-5.15.
commercial_solution_readiness: Packaging, distribution, signing, notarization, enterprise administration, operational runbooks, support, and commercial release decisions remain out of scope.
Cargo license and publish settings remain owner-decision items and are not changed by RRP-5.15.
